## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows `type(scope): summary` (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes (lint, typecheck, test, build, size)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] A changeset is included if anything inside `packages/` changed (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, package README or docs/)
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies in published packages
- [ ] No em or en dashes in docs or UI strings
